_comment: The four reference sets for Part 2. Each one exists to stress a different axis of the
renderer, so they are not interchangeable and a capture is not 'done' because one of them
landed. Status is recorded per set and is the honest state, not the intent.

targets.why: 21 hidden layer plots that exist only as fill anchors, plus two moving averages and 22 colorer plots. The natural stress case for fills, hidden plots and per-band colour.

A control, not a target. Small and independently understood, which is why it was the one that exposed the inverted colorer index. Captured alongside the two member scripts in every set so every capture has a component whose answer is known in advance.

_target_naming: CONFIRMED by the owner 2026-09-09: the Part 2 targets are AtTheAsk's own 'Uncharted Clouds'
and 'Uncharted Volume'. TradingView's built-in Volume is captured alongside as a bonus control
and has its own page, docs/pine/linemap-volume-builtin.md.

sets.why: The baseline. Daily bars, a liquid symbol, enough history that no plot is inside its warmup.

artifacts.note: images re-shot at 1835x895 with UT Vol rendering; see README section 4b

sets.why: A second symbol at the same timeframe, so a difference between A and B is about the DATA and never about the timeframe.

artifacts.note: images re-shot at 1835x895 with UT Vol rendering; see README section 4b

sets.why: Weekly. Changes bar spacing and the time axis without changing the symbol, which is where x-coordinate and label-collision bugs surface.

artifacts.note: images re-shot at 1835x895 with UT Vol rendering; see README section 4b

sets.note: The final weekly bar equals set A's final daily bar exactly. That is correct: 2026-09-07 was Labor Day, so the week beginning then holds a single session so far.

sets.why: Intraday 4H. Sessions, gaps and a non-continuous time axis — the case where a renderer that assumes evenly spaced bars finally breaks.

artifacts.note: images re-shot at 1835x895 with UT Vol rendering; see README section 4b

sets.note: Five distinct gaps between consecutive bars in one 300-bar window: 14400s (the 4h step), 72000s (overnight), 244800s (a weekend), 331200s (a holiday weekend) and 241200s (a weekend exactly one hour short — a DST transition). This is the set that earns its place.

_outstanding: No table or label crops as separate files: neither target draws a Pine table, and UT Vol's
labels (the cyan 'HV1' annotation, the orange 'Range' readout) are inside the full and crop40
images already. The first script that draws a real table will need its own crop.
The built-in Volume's per-index palette (the two histogram hues) was not captured.
A line map for Uncharted Volume is not written yet — its 12 plots are captured in all four sets.
